bayts.text: He (Muḥammad) is the one besides whom I have seen no one, nor do I see any other in anything: he has guided and bestowed.
Muḥammad — upon whom He (Allah) sends blessing and peace — is my means to Him, and to me he has led the Word.
The Most Generous (Allah) has filled me with an abiding joy, for I am His intimate friend, beloved and servant.
To Him my words are addressed: He has erased all turbidity, and has turned the traitor towards others than us.
You supported us against the enemies and they were overcome, and towards others than us they turned back humbled.
May the peace of the Everlasting (Allah), who has led reward to me, be upon him (Muḥammad) who made me heir to rectitude.
Upon him (Muḥammad) who wished that I be his Servant (Khadīm), be the two salutations of peace of the Ancient Maker of creation.
To Him (Allah) to whom my whole being belongs in worship goes my praise; and whoever opposed me, He has annihilated.
The kingdom of Him (Allah) who has no rival has led to me what is hidden from the one who vies.
The All-Knowing (Al-ʿAlīm), the All-Aware (Al-Khabīr) spoke to me in intimacy, and the Vast (Al-Wāsiʿ), the Great (Al-Kabīr) lavished His gifts upon me.
The Beautiful (Al-Jamīl) filled me with joy — how excellent a Bestower of benefit! —; the King (Al-Malik) raised me, and He is the Exalter (Ar-Rāfiʿ).
He (Allah) who leads gifts to me has driven my adversities towards whoever once aimed at my harm.
The Sovereign, the Sovereign, the Sovereign (Al-Mālik), He to whom belongs the bestowal of all possession, has given me possession of:
a great reward, a recompense and a requital; and the promise made to me in Ramaḍān has been fulfilled.
The reward of Him (Allah) with whom nothing runs out has reached me, and exhaustion has never touched it.
The service of the best of the worlds, Aḥmad (Muḥammad) — upon him the two salutations of peace of the Generous (Allah), the Praised —
has gladdened the heart, purified my soul, and carried my adversities away towards others than me.
My pen gladdens the best of the worlds (Muḥammad) — upon him the two salutations of peace of Him (Allah) who removes pain.
To the Chosen One (Muḥammad) I have devoted all I possess; he has led benefit without harm, and (all things) have yielded in submission.
He (Muḥammad) is the Intercessor, he is the Valiant: through him my wrongdoing and my pains have been erased.
Muḥammad — may God bless him, together with the Family, the Companions and whoever is loyal to him —
has erased my affliction, has erased my illnesses, and through good pleasure my aims yield to me.
Our Prophet, the Chosen One (Al-Mukhtār), the best of the Prophets — upon him the two salutations of peace of my Beloved, my Lord (Allah).
To him (Muḥammad) I have led my whole being, openly and in secret; and he has guided me, and never (will he fail).
I have raised my service to the Means (Al-Wasīla, Muḥammad); may He (Allah) whose favour I behold send blessing upon him.
I have raised my service to the Effacer (Al-Māḥī, Muḥammad), the firm Support; and he has driven towards others than us whoever has gone astray.
He (Muḥammad) is the Prophet, the Messenger and the Intimate Friend (Al-Khalīl); he is the Beloved (Al-Ḥabīb), and he multiplies the little.
May the peace of the Everlasting (Allah), who never ceases to be the Everlasting Refuge (Aṣ-Ṣamad), be upon the Prophet and Messenger Aḥmad (Muḥammad).
Make everlasting the two salutations of peace of the Generous, the Everlasting Refuge (Allah), upon the Prophet, my means, Muḥammad.
Upon the Prophet, my means, Muḥammad, make everlasting the two salutations of peace of the Generous, the Everlasting Refuge (Allah).
O Allah, O Powerful (Al-Qādir), O All-Powerful (Al-Muqtadir), O You whose generosity hastens towards me!
Today and before today I have addressed You in intimate prayer, and for me You have set the breaking of the fast (ʿĪd al-Fiṭr) above the fast.
I have come with this ode, giving You thanks through it; and already before it You had led Your grace to me.
I have adorned this ode of mine with thanksgiving, and You never cease, O my Sovereign, to be the Appreciative (Ash-Shakūr).
You have honoured me with the honour of Him (Allah) who does what He wills, and all I have wished of You has come to pass.
You have given me, O Lord, from Your own presence, a wise Remembrance (the Qur'an), and I am well pleased with You.
You have blessed for me, O Lord, my letters and all else, and lavished goodness upon me.
Because You are the Generous, You have given me possession of what has led glad tidings and honour to me.
You have given me what made the heart forget all the harm gone by; You have erased the darknesses.
He (Allah) to whom none is equal has rewarded me with that by which He drove towards others than me whoever denied.
My Lord has honoured me with "Say: He is God, the One" and "none is equal to Him" (Sūrat al-Ikhlāṣ).
God, the Generous, the Everlasting Refuge, spoke to me in intimacy, an intimacy by which He sufficed me against grief.
The Most Generous (Allah) has turned towards me the most beneficial of generosities, and harm, without my repelling it, has ceased for me.
I ask Him that this ode be a wonder breaking the ordinary (khāriqa), fruitful in benefit.
O Ever-Living (Al-Ḥayy), O Self-Subsisting (Al-Qayyūm), pour forth blessing and peace upon him (Muḥammad) who came with the most beautiful of Words (the Qur'an).
Upon him (Muḥammad) who came with the most beautiful of Words pour forth blessing and peace, and accept this word of mine.
Bestow Your grace upon whoever reads these letters, with a goodness that surpasses all imagining.
For the composer of these letters make the gain everlasting, O You who sufficed him against this delusion and the barking (of slanderers).
O Protector, O All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān), O Most Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm), O Ever-Living (Al-Ḥayy), O Self-Subsisting (Al-Qayyūm), O You who honour me!
Your servant, the Servant (Khadīm ar-Rasūl), has addressed You in intimate prayer, with blessing, greeting with peace him (Muḥammad) who drives away the haters.
